authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6984 nava nine explicitly gives Khowar nyoh, with its y unexplained and h possibly Iranian-influenced. Survey nīu is compared with that numeral family, retaining its vowel sequence and lack of final h. Exact survey form nīu is preserved.
